payload.value:
## Trigger

When a maintainer releases an already verified change, I want one prepared candidate to pass every required gate before tagging, so I can publish promptly without repeating manual preparation or testing different content.

## Demonstrated failure

The Codex policy removal passed a scratch release, but a later tutorial prose edit broke the positive control in test_docs_claims_tutorial during the main push. The local candidate was already tagged and was withheld. Preparing the replacement required full and fast verification in main and scratch, trial release, post-tag checks, tutorial replay, another whole suite and publication hooks. Separate mandatory steps repeatedly verified equivalent inputs while the person waited.

## Proposed outcome

Prepare and verify a single immutable candidate; automate tutorial claim updates; expose phase progress, elapsed time and evidence reuse; refuse content drift before creating a tag. Include all generated files in candidate equivalence, accounting explicitly for generation timestamps. Publish the tested bytes rather than allowing untested edits after the trial.

## Confirmation Plan

Measure the present release sequence and compare it with a release through the improved command in a disposable repository. Exercise successful publication preparation, a failed tutorial control, changed candidate content and a reused passing result. Retain every required gate and prove the failure cases create no tag. Record manual steps, check executions and elapsed time before and after.
